g.text: Everything that happens before a client even has an IP to connect to
Each hop above is usually cached -- a short TTL means faster failover
but constant re-asking; a long TTL is cheap but slow to change.
Anycast: the Network Routes, Not DNS
NOT via a DNS lookup deciding
Same IP, announced from many places -- routers pick the nearest
announcement. An outage there resolves via BGP withdrawal, not a TTL expiring.
